title: Orchard Bloom Pollination Window
dataSources: Beehive weight and entrance activity (`beehive:weight`), hive climate (`beehive:climate`), brooder climate (`brooder:climate`), egg counts (`coop:egg`), rain-barrel level (`rainbarrel:level`), greenhouse climate (`greenhouse:climate`), orchard bloom observations (`orchard:bloom`), and milking logs (`milking:session`).
app: Homestead telemetry from beehive monitors, coop sensors, brooder controls, greenhouse sensors, rain barrels, orchard logs, and milking records streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, LoRaWAN, and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=orchard:bloom
| stats count as bloom_windows avg(pollinator_visits) as avg_pollinator_visits by tree_variety bloom_stage
| sort tree_variety bloom_stage
description: Counts bloom windows and average pollinator visits by tree variety so overlap and pollination opportunity are easier to plan.
value: Fruit set depends on timing, and this view helps you understand whether varieties are blooming together in a useful way.
implementation: Log bloom-stage observations and nearby pollinator visits for each tree variety through the season.
visualization: Table of bloom windows and average pollinator visits by variety and stage.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces when each fruit tree is blooming and whether pollinators are visiting at the right time.
